name: Lauki Thepla
steps: Squeeze grated bottle gourd lightly, keeping its juice. Mix flour, gourd, yogurt, chopped coriander and chilli, turmeric, cumin, salt and 10 ml oil.
Knead to a soft nonsticky dough, adding retained gourd juice a spoonful at a time only if needed. Rest covered for 15 minutes.
Divide into eight balls. Dust lightly with flour and roll each into a thin 16–18 cm circle.
Cook each on a hot tawa until spots appear, turn, brush with some remaining oil, and cook both sides until golden spots form.
Stack in a clean cloth to keep soft. Serve warm with plain yogurt.
tips: Do not add water before checking the moisture released by the gourd.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
